definition.name: Pinned LLVM21 stack and TLS context control only

steps.name: Build only the parser and C context source mechanism
steps.run:
cargo test --locked -p latent-component-threading --lib --target-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-context-tools"
cargo build --locked -p latent-component-threading --bin c-context --target-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-context-tools"

steps.name: Execute fixed C compiler and actual core-Wasm callback controls
Retain source mechanism observations, including failure

with.name: c-context-mechanism-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/c-context-mechanism/report.json
${{ runner.temp }}/c-context-mechanism/*.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/c-context-mechanism/*.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/c-context-mechanism/*.ll
${{ runner.temp }}/c-context-mechanism/selected/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/c-context-mechanism/selected/*.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/c-context-mechanism/tls-keys/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/c-context-mechanism/tls-keys/*.wasm
